description.summary: a workspace as an image capture source

protocol.description: Olo's own: a workspace of a display as an ext_image_capture_source_v1, captured with ext-image-copy-capture as an output is. While the display shows that workspace, its frames are what the display shows; while it shows another, they are that workspace's windows as they are now, over its desktop, at the display's size and scale. Offered on app_server's direct socket only (Olo's own programs: Show on AirPlay).

request.name: create_source

description.summary: a source for one workspace of a display

request.description: Workspace number `workspace` (from 0) of the display `output`; one past the last there is is captured as the last.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Sources made with it are kept.
